      "cue": "Properties of isosceles triangles",
      "explanation": "In an isosceles triangle, the angles opposite the equal sides are equal. Since AB = AC, the angles at B and C must be equal.",

      "stepId": "step_1"

      "cue": "Triangle angle sum theorem",
      "explanation": "The sum of the three interior angles of any triangle is always 180 degrees. So, angle A + angle B + angle C = 180°.",

      ],

      "stepId": "step_2"
    },
    {
      "cue": "Solving a simple equation",
      "explanation": "Now you have two facts: angle B = angle C, and angle A + 2 * angle B = 180°. Since angle A is 40°, you can substitute it in and solve for angle B.",
      "focus": [],

    }

  "steps": [
    {
      "explanation": "Because the triangle is isosceles at A (AB = AC), the base angles must be equal.",
      "geometryActions": [],

      "reason": "Tổng ba góc trong một tam giác",
      "title": "Lập phương trình góc",
      "uses": []
    },

      "explanation": "Substitute the known values (angle A = 40° and angle C = angle B) into the equation and solve for angle B.",
